messages.subject: shiny website not accessible
parts:
Hello,

I'm a long time Shiny user and I just noticed that my website is no longer accessible. 

http://spark.rstudio.com/climatetool/myapp/

Is this because the server is down? Please let me know what I can do to get it back up and running. 

Thanks in advance.

Best,
Sarah

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: shiny website not accessible
parts:
Hi Sarah,
We have actually shutdown Spark and glimmer.  We sent out a few notices over the past 6 weeks about it and how you can migrate but it appears that you may not have received them.  We actually have them up for a few hours under oldspark.rstudio.com and oldglimmer.rstudio.com if you would like to get your application off of them.  You should hopefully be able to easily deploy it to our free plan on shinyapps.io.

Best,
Tareef
